description: We are six students passionate about space exploration and storytelling. We aim to share the stories of NASA's past missions and their scientific discoveries.
summary:
Our team, Cosmic Blast, created a digital storybook titled "The Forgotten Explorers" for the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten".

This storybook introduces four remarkable space explorers: the Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner, Ingenuity, and Pioneer 10 and 11. Through creative storytelling, we share their missions, journeys, important discoveries, achievements, and what happened to them after their missions.

Our project aims to bring attention to these space explorers whose contributions are often overlooked. By presenting scientific information in an interesting and easy-to-understand story format, we hope to help readers learn about the history of space exploration and appreciate the machines that helped humanity discover the unknown.

Although their missions have ended or communication has been lost, their contributions will never be forgotten.
details:
The Forgotten Explorers – Stories of the Machines Left Behind in Space

Our project is an educational digital storybook that explores the journeys of four important space explorers: the Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner Rover, Ingenuity Mars Helicopter, and Pioneer 10 and 11.

The storybook presents the missions through creative storytelling, allowing each explorer to tell its own story. It explains why these machines were sent into space, their missions, important discoveries, challenges, and where they are now.

The main aim of this project is to create awareness about space exploration and help people understand the contributions of robotic explorers. It makes scientific information easier and more interesting to learn, especially for students and young readers.

Our project combines scientific information with storytelling in a chapter-based digital format. Its creative approach helps readers connect with the explorers and understand their importance in space exploration.

The project was prepared using digital document and presentation tools, along with AI-assisted tools for content organization and preparation.
